svg.font-family: Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Contact, proximity and projection printing
svg.desc: Three panels: contact printing with the mask on the resist, proximity printing with a gap g that blurs the edges, and projection printing through a lens onto a reduced image field; under each, the intensity reaching the resist against the mask pattern.
svg.text: A gap g protects the mask;
Schematic, not to scale. Dashed: mask pattern; solid: 1-D scalar model (arbitrary units).
